items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: Yeah, I was at his funeral. Oh, did I happen to be passing then? They told me it was Girard's funeral and I stood by, yeah.

ctx.x: Not too much. No, I think Emmett came after we left.
He came later, but then he died... After we left. You know, like old Girard. He died even faster than Girard. But I understand he played very well. No, those years I was out of town.
Yeah, that's what I wanted to establish. When did he come up? I don't know.
